title: Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) Underwriting Table: Required Limits and Minimum Backing Packages by Filing State
content:
**Rule of the table.** Under Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44), each certificate draws its required limits (bodily injury per person, bodily injury per accident, property damage) for the filing state from one schedule kept in the Owner Auto Policy charter. Its minimum backing package for a filing state is the lowest package of the backing product whose limits satisfy that requirement.

### Limits schedule each certificate draws on

| Certificate | Schedule giving the required limits for the filing state |
|---|---|
| SR-22 Owner Certificate | the Owner Auto Policy's state minimum limits schedule |
| SR-22 Operator Certificate | the Owner Auto Policy's state minimum limits schedule |
| SR-22 Owner-Operator Certificate | the Owner Auto Policy's state minimum limits schedule |
| FR-44 Owner Certificate | the Owner Auto Policy's FR-44 required limits schedule |
| FR-44 Operator Certificate | the Owner Auto Policy's FR-44 required limits schedule |
| FR-44 Owner-Operator Certificate | the Owner Auto Policy's FR-44 required limits schedule |

### Minimum backing package by filing state

| Certificate | FL | VA | TX | GA | AZ | OH |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SR-22 Owner Certificate | Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability | Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability | Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability | Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability | Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability | Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability |
| SR-22 Operator Certificate | Cardinal Point Non-Owner Minimum Limits | Cardinal Point Non-Owner Minimum Limits | Cardinal Point Non-Owner Minimum Limits | Cardinal Point Non-Owner Minimum Limits | Cardinal Point Non-Owner Minimum Limits | Cardinal Point Non-Owner Minimum Limits |
| SR-22 Owner-Operator Certificate | Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability | Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability | Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability | Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability | Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability | Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability |
| FR-44 Owner Certificate | Cardinal Point 100/300/50 Liability | Cardinal Point 100/200/50 Liability | not a filing state | not a filing state | not a filing state | not a filing state |
| FR-44 Operator Certificate | Cardinal Point Non-Owner 100/300/50 | Cardinal Point Non-Owner 100/200/50 | not a filing state | not a filing state | not a filing state | not a filing state |
| FR-44 Owner-Operator Certificate | Cardinal Point 100/300/50 Liability | Cardinal Point 100/200/50 Liability | not a filing state | not a filing state | not a filing state | not a filing state |

### Reading the table

- An Owner or Owner-Operator certificate is measured against packages of the Owner Auto Policy. An Operator certificate is measured against packages of the Named Non-Owner Policy.
- For the same certificate type, the FR-44 minimum package for Florida and the one for Virginia differ. The SR-22 minimum package is the same in every filing state.
- *Hypothetical lookup:* for an FR-44 Operator Certificate filed with Virginia, the table gives Cardinal Point Non-Owner 100/200/50 as the lowest Named Non-Owner package whose limits satisfy the requirement.
